question_stem:
A steel ball on the end of a thin string oscillates with small oscillations, as shown in Fig. 5.1.

{{figure:figure_5_1}}

Fig. 5.1 (not to scale)

The displacement of the centre of the ball from its equilibrium position is $x$.

parts.label: (a)
(a)(i)
parts.text: Explain how Fig. 5.2 shows that the oscillations of the ball are simple harmonic.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the period $T$ of the oscillations.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem: At time $t = 0$, when the displacement of the ball has its maximum value, the ball is immersed in a trough containing thick oil so that the ball is just below the surface of the oil. This results in the subsequent motion of the ball being heavily damped.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State what is meant by damping.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
